summary: Ship commits keep reintroducing the retired schemaDelta field into pending.json entries they never shipped -- trunk's queue is corrupt again right now.

per.section: 2. Entry schema splits: engine core + chain-declared extension

edit.description: find & fix why commitPendingUpdate's rewrite reintroduces a retired field into entries it didn't ship; prime suspect is overlapping-tick staleness -- see notes
regression pinning the mechanism found: a wave shipping one entry must leave untouched entries' field sets byte-identical apart from gate/observedFiles
Fixed bullet once root cause identified

tests.asserts: after commitPendingUpdate ships one entry, remaining entries serialize with exactly their pre-wave key set -- no reintroduced or foreign keys

acceptance: pending.json on trunk parses clean against the dogfood extension after a ship commit; a regression test pins the mechanism found; two consecutive ship waves leave untouched entries byte-identical apart from gate/observedFiles.
notes: Repro: 52596fb clean; 669790e (build, never touches pending.json) unchanged; 4c27476 (chore ship, sole writer) re-adds schemaDelta to the 2 untouched entries. src/+dist/ grep clean, so it's raced/stale data, not hardcoded. Same corruption recurred once before (4ac18d6, hand-fixed by 52596fb) -- fix didn't address the mechanism. Untracked .flume/loop.pid suggests a live supervisor; check overlapping ticks racing a stale in-memory pending snapshot onto disk (last-writer-wins) first.
